entry.title: New: Bill 198 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Failed
entry.content:
AMENDS THE STATE LAND USE BOUNDARIES MAPS FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI BY CHAGING THE DISTRICT CLASSIFICATION FROM THE AGRICULTURAL DISTRICT TO THE RURAL DISTRICT AT WAIMEA, SOUTH KOHALA, HAWAIʻI, COVERED BY TAX MAP KEY: 6-4-024:027 ; and LAAC-31

Latest action: LAAC: Postponed to the call of the chair - 3/6/2025 LAAC-16: Recommended passage on first reading - 5/20/2025 Council: Bill 198 fails due to 8 noes; LAAC-16 is not adopted - 06/04/25
